metadata.description: Fine-grained RBAC (GRANT + DENY property/label scope) over an ENCRYPTED multi-tenant server (AES-256-GCM at rest): provision isolated tenant databases + roles/users/grants + DENY and assert the allow/deny/cross-tenant/DENY matrix over REST and Bolt, with ciphertext-on-disk, offline key rotation and encrypted-backup proofs.

notes: storage.bytes_fsynced is a proxy: the WAL on-disk byte count (every committed WAL byte is fsynced before commit acknowledgement), not a directly-observed fsync counter.

STORAGE FIX (rmp #696): the primary storage section meters a REAL tenant database store (tenant_a/graphus.store), not the empty default 'graphus' db; the all-tenants store/WAL SUM rides in as tenant_store_bytes/tenant_wal_bytes params.

OVERHEAD FIX (rmp #696): enc_store_bytes vs clear_store_bytes now measure two ISOLATED databases (overhead_enc / overhead_clear) each seeded with the IDENTICAL tenant_a dataset, so the delta is purely per-page GCM overhead (apples-to-apples); the timing is a coarse single-run figure.

RBAC allow/deny/cross-tenant/DENY matrix asserted over BOTH REST and Bolt from one deterministic manifest; the hermetic security_verify proved ciphertext-on-disk, offline key rotation and the encrypted backup roundtrip.

graphus_auth_failures_total moved by 1 over the window. CONFIRMED server finding: REST DATA-PLANE 401s (missing/invalid Bearer on /db/*/tx/commit) and /auth/login failures do NOT increment this counter (they only emit an audit record via RestAuthObserver); only Bolt auth failures and the /metrics-endpoint auth gate bump it. The demo bumps it with a deliberate bad-Bearer GET /metrics (an unauthenticated request that IS rejected) plus, when the Bolt leg runs, the unauthenticated Bolt connection.
Live measurement of graphus-server pid 202651 over 5.000s uptime; CPU is the server's cumulative since-boot usage (the process is dedicated to this workload), RSS is sampled from the live process.
